title: Mall design
content: My dreams don't always feature a mall, but almost always include a large building that comprises the entire geographic world in my dream, so MallWorld resonates with me. The design of my "malls" varies quite a lot. Sometimes it's a giant office building, sometimes a school, or hospital, or similar institution. Sometimes it's a huge labyrinthine house. Last night it was a series of interconnected buildings, kind of like markets you sometimes see in older European cities, but with no access to the outdoors. Just wondered if anyone could relate.
